about: Points of no return and missable quest steps. Each entry was traced in the game's own flow scripts (tools/gamedata/flowindex.json): its reward item IDs, the script that gives them and, where possible, the story flag that marks the deadline. Community guides (SenseOS, GamerFuzion, PowerPyx, GrindnStrat, AllThings.how) were used to find candidates and wording. Tags are EventPipeline.GlobalTags. Deadlines were cross-checked against real save history: an entry is only marked missed automatically when its point of no return is confirmed (lockedByPonr). Each point's chapter is the story quest active around it in the user's saves (last save before / first save after the flag).

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Defeating Peng Meng, the Axemaster
pointsOfNoReturn.note: Talk to the frightened deserter in the village first.

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Defeating Bai Chilian, Lady of the Twin Serpents
pointsOfNoReturn.note: No warning. Closes most Weeping Creek / Crimson Forest tales: Feather Bow, A Healer's Mercy, Honor Among Thieves, Festering Secret, the first half of Secrets of the Baishan Sect.

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Killing the "Village Auntie" puppet
pointsOfNoReturn.note: Talk to the Sleeping Flower-Masked Weaver first: the puppet holds her soul.

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Defeating Mu Xiaokui
pointsOfNoReturn.note: Closes Fiend Saws (five ribbons) and the Wild Oriole Sword pickup on the boardwalk.

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Opening the serpent-statue door into Mirage Estate (Serpent Eye, Tongue and Fang)
pointsOfNoReturn.note: The game warns here. Nine Crimson Forest bells go dark for good and Mirrorwood is buried in snow; finish the purple tales first.
pointsOfNoReturn.chapter: The Heart's Trail / The Four Serpent Houses

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Fighting Leng Tu
pointsOfNoReturn.note: Closes Secrets at the Heart of the Lake and the Lóng Pillar trials (needed for the best ending).

pointsOfNoReturn.name: Going past Inanis's warning in the Soulrend mountains
pointsOfNoReturn.note: Leads into the final battle; you can't leave until the ending has played.

missables.how: Talk to the frightened deserter in the village BEFORE killing the Axemaster (Peng Meng). He tips you off about the stone-axe amulet; then examine the Axemaster's grave to pick up Boulderguard.

missed.text: The Axemaster died before you talked to the deserter, so the grave gives nothing.

tags: xg.村庄.害怕的逃兵对话后
fix.text: Adds the deserter's tip. Then examine the Axemaster's grave in game to pick Boulderguard up.

missables.before: Defeating Bai Chilian
missables.how: Take the Broken-String Bow at the Ruthless Archer Camp (the dying Featherbow Archer) and return it to the Brooding Old Archer on the rooftop by the Outpost bell. He gives you the Feather Bow. Hand it in right away.

missables.before: Reaching the Thieves' Camp with Zhang still caged
missables.how: Free Quick Hand Zhang from the cage by the Trail of Cages bell (turn the crank wheel), then bring his treasures to his hideouts (Snuff Bottle, Bloodstained Seal, the Ancient Crossbow key, and more in later regions).

ready.text: Zhang is free: keep bringing treasures to his hideouts.

fix.text: Adds the Flying Dagger and Goldblaze you don't have.

missables.before: Handing Zhang's treasures in anywhere else

missables.source: BPF_XiaoZhang_XMSZ gives AC_Electrified.

missables.before: Defeating Bai Chilian
missables.how: Beat the Nimble Thief near the Outlaw Trap bell, carry his blood letter to the Gentle Thief and answer his three questions correctly.

missables.how: Give the Wounded Thief the Thief's Manual in time, or he dies. When the Stately Monk speaks, say you don't believe him (believing turns him to stone).

missables.name: A Dream of Motherhood (the weaver's tale)
missables.before: Killing the "Village Auntie" puppet before talking to the weaver
missables.how: Talk to the Sleeping Flower-Masked Weaver in Village of Lu first; that starts the tale. Then find the puppet holding her soul (the "Village Auntie"), defeat it and go back to her body. If the puppet dies before you ever talked to her, she dies too and the tale never starts. Her Mother's Talisman can still be picked up on that path.

ready.text: Tale started: defeat the puppet holding her soul, then return to her body.

missed.text: The weaver died before you ever talked to her, so the tale never started.

missables.noFix: No fix: editing the save can't replay the tale. No item is lost: the Mother's Talisman still drops on this path.
missables.source: BPF_NvZhi: first talk (ljc.女织.第一次对话之后) → BeginQuest RuMengQiZi; ljc.击杀.大娘亲 + ljc.女织.死亡 when the puppet (EnemyName_041 "Village Auntie") dies; LootItems AC_BreakRegen. Missed in every save of this playthrough (both flags 2026-11-03 22:14).

missables.name: Fiend Saws & Wild Oriole Sword (Mu Xiaokui)
missables.before: Taking the elevator down to Mu Xiaokui
missables.how: Collect all five of Mu Xiaokui's ribbons before her boss fight. After her last health bar she calls in Iron Fiend and Jade Dancer for an extra phase. Afterwards pick up the Wild Oriole Sword on the boardwalk before leaving: the elevator breaks behind you.

noneTags: ljc.沐小葵.满足额外剧情条件
missed.text: She was defeated before all five ribbons were found.

fix.text: Adds the extra phase's rewards that you don't have.

missables.source: BPF_MuXiaoKuiSiDai (ribbons), BPF_MuXiaoKuiDeath (extra phase; YuuBlade, LuanYing, TU_02002, K_05002), BPF_LuanYingDiaoLuo.

missables.name: War Wagon (Old Man Gen, The Journey Home)
missables.region: Village of Lu → Pangzhen → Meigu Lake
missables.before: Refusing Gen's request (he then goes to Pangzhen alone)
missables.how: At the Old Man Gen's Hideout bell, agree to his request (don't answer "I'm short on time"): he gives the Brass Key. In his house with the yellow lantern in Pangzhen's backstreet find the Old Wooden Comb and return it to Gen at the Village of Lu gate; later he gives the War Wagon at the Frozen Lake Dock bell. Follow it through in one go: players report it can also break if left half-done.

ready.text: You agreed to help Gen: find the comb in Pangzhen's backstreet.

missables.source: BPF_LJC_LaoGenTou (choices: agree → branch 3-A, key; refuse → branch 3-B), BPF_PZ_LaoGenTou (3-B: Gen's body in the backstreet, pz.老根头.第一次对话之后, gives K_05004 and finishes the quest), BPF_CollectMuShuZi (comb), BPF_LaoGenTou gives NiTouChe.

anyTag: pz.老根头.第一次对话之后
missed.text: The quest took Gen's other branch: he went to Pangzhen alone and you found his body, so the War Wagon is never handed over.

missables.before: Fighting the Seven Stars sword formation
missables.how: When you meet the Red-Clad Swordswoman (Red), don't kill her: let her swing off across the chain. She joins the Seven Stars formation for a double boss fight, and her memory afterwards gives the Twin Fish Pendant.

missed.text: You killed her early, so the Seven Stars fight ran without her.

missables.name: Broken Vessel (Secrets of the Baishan Sect)
missables.before: Bai Chilian (accepting the tale) and the Mandate Encampment boss (Wu Lengshuang)
missables.how: Accept the tale from Lanlan on the big bridge by the Thieves' Camp bell. In the Mandate Encampment defeat Wu Lengshuang at The Confinement bell before the main boss, and fight Yubi only once the 'defeat Bi Taotao's puppet form' objective appears.
missables.source: BPF_JianOuQiangOu_Death gives AC_HeavyAttackDamage; bsmw.击杀.乌冷霜 marks Wu Lengshuang.

missables.name: Hero's Courage (The Undying Heroic Spirit)
missables.before: Three failed releases
missables.how: In the Order's tavern, the Wolf Leader asks you to free six masters. Only release them while he kneels; a hit after the kneel ends counts as a failure, and three failures end the tale.
missables.source: BPF_BuMieXiaDan_Memory_1–4 (I_06006 shards → TU_19006).

missables.name: Snow and Blood (Ledger of Atonement)
missables.before: Your reply to the Agonized Ironmask
missables.how: The Agonized Ironmask starts the tale; most guides say pick the harsher reply. Winning lets the puppet offer Bai Xue, who gives Snow and Blood.
missables.source: AC_Bleed (Bai Xue).

missables.name: Statue of the Loyal Hero (A Severed Mindseal, Spectral Blade)
missables.region: Weeping Creek Valley → Pangzhen → Blood-Red Forest → Soulrend Cliff
missables.before: Going past Inanis's warning without all three Primal Stones handed over
missables.how: Each time you meet the friendly Shadow Warden (Spectral Blade), find him a Primal Stone and hand it over: Weeping Creek Valley (the stone is with the Sha-Chi Tower's upper mechanism), Pangzhen / Meigu Lake, then the Blood-Red Forest. Each meeting's script checks the stones already given, so keep the chain going as each meeting opens; players report it breaks if left behind. With all three given he waits on Soulrend Cliff before the final battle and gives the Statue of the Loyal Hero, the Soul Temper material for the Crescent Blade.

ready.text: All three Primal Stones given: he hands over the statue on Soulrend Cliff.

fix.text: Adds the Statue of the Loyal Hero.

missables.source: BPF_XiGu_GuiCai / BPF_JMKD_GuiCai / BPF_XSSL_GuiCai (stones: xg/jmkd/xssl.鬼差.给鬼差浑源石, item I_01002; each checks the others' flags), BPF_DHY_GuiFengKe (needs xssl.鬼差.给鬼差浑源石; gives TU_13001, sets dhs.鬼差.死亡). This playthrough: statue 2026-11-18 05:14, point of no return 05:41.

missables.how: When Lu Sanqian asks for Rootless Dew, give it to him; refusing means he never reaches The Lady's Shrine. The letter he writes afterwards is also needed for Cui's tale.

missables.source: BPF_LuJieYuan_FenTou (dhs.决战前Npc.小翠); TU_11007.
